title: Collection runner
brief: Running a collection or folder from the app: how a run starts (tree context menu Run…, collection settings, command palette), its setup (environment, stop on first failure, delay), the live run (per request method, name, status, time, size, tests; the current one; Stop), the summary, opening a request's result (response and tests) and a failed run. Built on the bolt-v2 shell and DBFlux's results grid and tasks panel.

artboards.title: Run document with results grid
artboards.tradeoff: Full width for the grid and a tests-beside-response pane, close to DBFlux's results panel; the run takes a document tab, so checking it means leaving the request being edited

artboards.title: Setup modal and docked run panel
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the request in view and reuses the response area for results, like DBFlux's tasks panel; the panel is short, so long runs scroll and the setup is gone once the modal closes

artboards.title: Runs sidebar and folder-grouped report
artboards.tradeoff: Runs become first-class: earlier runs to compare, folder totals and failures first, results open in place; adds a rail entry and a sidebar, and folding hides per-request detail until opened
